        int result = 0;
        byte b;
        while ((b = dis.readByte()) <= ' ') ;
        boolean negative = false;
        if (b == '-') {
            negative = true;
            b = dis.readByte();
        }
        do {
            result = result * 10 + (b - '0');
        } while ((b = dis.readByte()) >= '0' && b <= '9');
        return negative ? -result : result;
